case.question: Will the highest score achieved by a SpaceXAI Grok model on Humanity’s Last Exam in 2026 be 60% or higher?
case.literal_rule: Any SpaceXAI Grok model reaches >=60 on the metric labeled HLE Accuracy (or clear equivalent) by 2026-12-31 23:59 ET. Calibration Error and other metrics do not count. Named primary source https://agi.safe.ai/; if unavailable, remain open while data may return; after deadline/permanent unavailability use official HLE alternative if available, otherwise NO. This packet does not decide resolution.
